text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the year draws to a close, I receive an

invitation from Seeking the Pearl to an

end-of-year party, but when I reach the
location
of our supposed party...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer. Exactly on time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know what you're thinking. You must
be
wondering if this is really where we're
having a
party, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Let's light up the evening sky
with our
wings!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whirrr... Tak, tak, tak...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I got my dad to pull some strings
and
chartered it for us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now let's take to the skies and bask in
some
breathtaking night scenery!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I'm strapped into a seat
and
soaring through an ocean of stars.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to show you this view. All
it takes
is a little change of perspective
to make your
familiar surroundings look
like brand-new,
brilliant pearls.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The lights from the stores, houses, and
offices,
the tiny glimmers from so many
people... All of
them have the capability
to become beautiful
jewels.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you got it! That's exactly correct!
Haha, you
beat me to it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll be arriving soon at tonight's
principal
attraction!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, after a brief flight, we arrive at
our
destination...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa! Pearl, you came by
helicopter?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your trainer is joining us too? You
know,
seeing you two arrive together
reminds me of the
parties we used to
have back home.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! My parents used
to link
arms like that when they went to
house parties
too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a rather common sight in the West,
isn't it?
Hehehe. Pearl looks right at
home doing that with
her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Season's greetings, my lovely guests!
Your shining
pearl has descended from
the sky!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! You don't even see people
come down
from the sky like that in hero
shows! Pearl, you're
so glamorous!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you two in your uniforms?
Don't
tell me you came straight from
training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we sure did! ☆ We rushed over as
soon as
we finished since we would've
been late
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Sorry. We should've dressed up a
little for
this...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No, no! It's no problem! In fact, it's
perfectly fine!
I figured this would
happen, so...

text_block_list.name: Biko and Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh!
Wooooow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! You prepared these for us?
They're so
cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Thank you! It suddenly feels more
like a
party now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Things are really starting to liven
up
now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This level of preparation and hospitality
is only
expected, given that I'm the host.
This is all for
the sake of a successful
and lovely party.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make the best possible
memories with
the friends I share a
special destined bond with.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But that's not all! I wanted to create the
ideal
opportunity for everyone to get to
know you
better!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm just that proud of you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why you brought us here.
Does the
secret to your strength lie in
him?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why you brought us here.
Does the
secret to your strength lie in
her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Grass Wonder. She's an
American-born
Yamato Nadeshiko,
possessing both talent and a
strong
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to put it
that way.
Haha. Have I piqued your
interest, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You have. I'm always interested in
learning about
strong opponents. Both
the paths they've walked
and the futures
they're aiming for fascinate me

endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You never know, I might end up asking
for your
help someday in the future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I like your fighting spirit! Okay! Let's talk
the
night away!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Well then, everyone! Let's get
this
party started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we enjoy the company and lively

festivities late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We land on the rooftop of a luxurious
hotel, and
as we head down the floors,
Seeking the Pearl
turns to me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
By the way, your present isn't just the
nighttime
view! I also had a special
dinner prepared just for
you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! My mom told me to treat
you to a
nice meal as thanks for always
taking good care
of me and made the
reservation herself, so it's
really a gift
from her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! My mom told me to treat
you to a
nice meal as thanks for always
taking good care
of me and made the
reservation herself, so it's
really a gift
from her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since my mom and dad often travel
overseas for
work, they seem to think
really highly of you for
always staying by
my side. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can't refuse a thank-you like this!
You might
think it's over the top, but
this is just how much
they want to show
you their appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm glad you understand. You're a

wonderful person who deserves a gift at
least this
special.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After all, I've only made it this far thanks
to your
constant support!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, come along. Let's enjoy a romantic
evening!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer—let's have a toast to
the
breathtaking scenery and a magical
evening!
Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this year's sparkling carrot juice is
really
good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It has such a rich terroir and crisp
sweetness.
Could this be from
Normandy?

text_block_list.name: Sommelier
text_block_list.text:
You are absolutely correct, ma'am. As
always,
your refined palate is
impeccably astute.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I've been drinking sparkling
carrot
juice ever since I was a child, so
it's not difficult
for me to tell each
bottle's origin.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What kind of flavors do you enjoy?
Allow me to
pick out our second bottle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the server brings us our after-meal
coffee, I
pull out the gift I'd prepared. I
hand it over to
Seeking the Pearl a little
nervously.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my! You brought a gift for me too?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you sooo much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you said this is "just a
little
something." Any gift from you is a
treasure in my
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I may be a gorgeous Umamusume—as
you can
clearly see—but that doesn't
mean that my gifts
need to be lavish or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What makes me happy are the thoughts
you
mulled over and the time you took
while trying to
decide what to get me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All of that is what creates such
stupendous
experiences for the both of
us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Ahaha! Say, is it okay if I go ahead
and
open this?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is absolutely amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our glamorous and romantic
holiday
evening draws to a close.
